name: Spicy Thai Red Curry-Basil Egg Salad Sandwich with Apple Mango Medley

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
1 mango
1 Gala apple
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the lime.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple; add to the bowl and stir to combine the fruit medley. Set aside.
Place mayo, curry paste, vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp Thai curry paste, red
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
½ tsp honey
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop eggs and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using a fork or potato masher, mash and combine the egg salad.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the egg salad and stir to combine.
Place half of the bread slices on a flat surface and divide egg salad between them; cover with remaining slices and press gently to adhere. Cut sandwiches in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and fruit medley between plates. Enjoy!
